meanings.morph: -en ending (masc. accusative, dative, plural after a possessive)

sentences.en: He has a mind of his own.

sentences.text: Sie lebt in ihrer eigenen Welt.
sentences.en: She lives in her own world.

sentences.text: Jeder muss seine eigenen Fehler machen.
sentences.en: Everyone has to make their own mistakes.

sentences.text: Ich habe es mit meinen eigenen Augen gesehen.
sentences.en: I saw it with my own eyes.

sentences.text: Die Kinder haben ihre eigenen Zimmer.
sentences.en: The children have their own rooms.

sentences.text: Du solltest deinen eigenen Weg gehen.
sentences.en: You should go your own way.
He has no children of his own.

sentences.text: In meinem eigenen Haus mache ich, was ich will.
sentences.en: In my own house I do what I want.
